summary: Operator site + ReservationFriend: one RV type (full hookups 30/50A) at $53 (Nov 2026 and Jun 2027), showers/laundry/dump/wifi, weekly/monthly on request, online booking. Site count (45) and year-round season (derived from old note) not stated by the operator, left. Price over $50 passes on the Good Sam 10%.
flags: Price gate: $53 a night on the operator's engine (Nov 2026 and Jun 2027) - over US$50, but it is a Good Sam Park (directory) and 10% off is $47.70, so it passes on the Good Sam rule; no gateway within 40 km. Google Maps 4.3 over 182 reviews (phone 573-324-3055); RV Life 4* $$ over 73.
Long-stay: weekly/monthly rates offered on request, but the nightly rate is on the online engine; not long-stay in character.
